title: Architecture Decision Record and Release Plan
negative_results: This ADR does not authorize a push; release is prepared locally and pushing to a public remote requires explicit operator authorization.
No prior release is reset and no public history is rewritten; rollback removes only the additive cwatlas package.

claims.statement: Design decisions are frozen (package = cwatlas, pure-numpy geodesy, canonical-vs-legacy firewall, authority registry, synthetic-only fixtures) with a v8.1.0 release target and an additive rollback strategy.
